title: Parity structure of the 3/2 Mahler recursion and 9/4 arithmetic obstructions in Lean 4
description: Machine-checked Lean 4 / Mathlib4 formalization of the arithmetic, symbolic-dynamical, and harmonic structure of the 3/2 Mahler recursion a(n+1) = ceil(3 a(n) / 2) (OEIS A061419 / A205083) and its 9/4 twin dynamics. Covers base-6/base-3 two-state automata, information windows, hexadecimal light-cone flips, F_2 linear splitting, 11-free Fibonacci pruning, Walsh zero correlation, R x Q_2 two-world Pade isolation, mod-9 anti-misfire gates, zero-entropy cages, discrete fluid certificates, 9/4 finite-roof obstructions, midpoint 36^K double-Cantor intersections, and global odd-frequency Fourier decay O(K^{-c}), verified with zero sorry and audited with Lean kernel replay (leanchecker) and nanoda.
